an5.265-271:1.1: pañca bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ … sotāpattiphalaṃ … sakadāgāmiphalaṃ … anāgāmiphalaṃ … arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an5.265-271:1.3: āvāsamacchariyaṃ kulamacchariyaṃ lābhamacchariyaṃ vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ akataññutaṃ akataveditaṃ
an5.265-271:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an5.265-271:2.1: pañca bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an5.265-271:2.3: āvāsamacchariyaṃ kulamacchariyaṃ lābhamacchariyaṃ vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ akataññutaṃ akataveditaṃ
an5.265-271:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātunti.
